exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Make sure to/try to do".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない
Verb ようにする

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! Verb ようにする matches "Make sure to/try to do".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is Verb ようにする.
exercises.explanation: Expresses effort or intention to make sure or try to do something.

exercises.question: Choose the correct meaning for: Verb ようにする.

Not as much/less than
Not as...as

exercises.correctFeedback: Correct! Verb ようにする means "Make sure to/try to do".
